text: おどるとき　はなびらが　ふれあい　ここちよい　おとが　なりひびく。

structure.jp: はなびらが　ふれあい
ここちよい　おとが　なりひびく。

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a plain verb means 'when'. おどるとき = 'when it dances'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: In written style the bare verb stem joins one action to the next, the same job as the て-form, like 'and'. はなびらが　ふれあい = 'the petals touch each other and'.
